basis: The full-period river temperature change from 2005 to 2014 is 23.9°C - 10.1°C = 13.8°C, as directly annotated by the plotted data points for those years. The task requires determining whether this change requires substantial-change follow-up. The dashboard provides no explicit threshold or policy for what constitutes a 'substantial' change. Under the absence of a stated policy, the default routing for unverified changes is routine monitoring. The option to archive is not justified, as the record is part of a monitoring review and has a clear full-period change. The public task does not specify a threshold, so the only public option is to route the change to routine monitoring for ordinary variation, as the substantial-change route requires an unstated criterion that is not supported by any public fact.
option_label: Keep the 2005 to 2014 river temperature change on routine monitoring for ordinary variation
